subject: mathematics
concept: Measuring length using non-standard units (e.g. counting paperclips or blocks)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student lines up virtual unit objects (blocks) end to end along an object and counts them
exercise.pictorial: Student counts pictured unit objects laid along a length to state the measurement
exercise.abstract: Student states a length in non-standard units from a described measuring scenario

misconception_flags: leaves gaps or overlaps between unit objects when measuring

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
